responsibility: Defines the x86 AVXVNNIINT16 intrinsic interface for 128-bit and 256-bit packed 16-bit dot-product accumulate operations. It conditionally enables `avxvnniint16` and exposes the signed/unsigned and saturating `dpws*`/`dpwu*` families on `__m128i` and `__m256i`, giving GCC a dedicated public API for the AVX VNNI INT16 extension distinct from the INT8 and AVX-512 VNNI headers.
